scope: PURA widget and public demo lifecycle, useful context, database ownership and support escalation; isolated validation only

browser.runner: Playwright 1.59.1, Chromium 153 from @sparticuz/chromium; local fixture, React StrictMode

tests.title: guest chat uses one model request, no history database calls and no welcome in model context
two submits in the same browser task admit one request
stop aborts the stream, removes partial output and restores the editable request
stop while saving a completed answer keeps the answer and does not resend
logout clears private content and subsequent guest requests never persist it
a stale response cannot populate a new conversation or unlock a newer request
account change during conversation creation prevents a subsequent model call
failure to save the user message stops before model inference
failure to save the answer preserves it without another model request
errors stay out of model context and real answers starting with Bienvenue stay in
history uses a single bounded query and stale history messages cannot replace a new chat
closing the widget aborts its pending response
loading a conversation and submitting in the same task cannot overlap
mobile controls remain visible and the demo can be stopped

regressionBeforeFix.observed: The reply used previous context and replaced the loading state. The same test passes after sharing one synchronous interaction slot.

decisions: One synchronous interaction slot for response generation and conversation loading; independent bounded history list.
Abort and invalidate on stop, close, account change, new conversation and unmount; stale completion cannot unlock newer work.
Only actual user/assistant text enters model context; input limits shared by browser and public endpoint; no silent truncation.
Guest chat stays in page memory; authenticated database history is owner-only; no anonymous row creation.
Daily demo quota must be explicitly true before inference. Caller session IDs are not rate-limit identities.
Support requires verified account ownership, stored history and provider acceptance plus database confirmation; client-supplied email/history ignored.
Do not claim current prices, unlimited access, automatic external actions or measured savings from these tests.
limits: Public chatbot and support rate limits remain per process; no distributed chatbot cost ledger or server-side idempotency for model calls.
Cancelling cannot undo writes or provider work already accepted; it does not promise a zero charge.
A failed/cancelled user message may remain in stored/local history; automatic retry/deduplication across requests is not implemented.
Owner-write access does not establish model provenance of assistant rows.
Support mail and confirmation DB update are not atomic. Resend idempotency is only 24 hours and requires identical payload; no automatic retry.
The migration preserves existing rows and rejects unreviewed policies, incomplete pairs or absent tables. Real schema compatibility and locking impact are unverified.
Whole frontend TypeScript is not passing: 103 baseline diagnostics remain. Fixture auth file has one Fast Refresh lint warning only.
The separate OmniRoute candidate pack 0.4.0 remains unconnected to production runtime.
